annotations.text: Entry point (PRD open Q1): shown as a quiet link-card after the song list. Alternative: a gear icon in the header — kept off to avoid competing with song cards / kid taps.

Flip, presets and manual on one screen (PRD Q2: flip as a row above presets). Metal + pastel preset palettes are placeholders — verify against best-selling toys before build.
Happy path = tap a preset, tap save: 2 taps.
Swatch picker as a bottom sheet (PRD Q3) — bigger targets for one-handed use than a popover. 12 fixed swatches, each with a pre-measured label color; no free color wheel.
Duplicate colors: non-blocking warning (existing amber chip tokens), save stays enabled — some real toys do repeat colors. The two matching bars get an amber ring.
